chooser.title: How do you want to add tasks?

file.label: From a file or link
file.needs: A JSON, CSV or zip file, or a dataset or repository link.

catalog.label: From the catalog
catalog.needs: Nothing. Pick a public benchmark and add it.

api.label: Tasks from your API
api.needs: Your OpenAPI file and a short policy. Uses your model key.

create.label: Create your own
create.needs: Your own questions or tickets, written here.

code.label: From code changes
code.needs: A repository with tests. Tasks come from its commits.

failures.label: From production failures
failures.needs: Traces from a connected source. Each failure becomes a test.

chooser.platformImport: Or import traces from another platform

add.draftMore: More actions for the draft of {{suite}}

catalog.addHint: Adds the benchmark to your project. Nothing runs and nothing is charged.
catalog.importHint: Import, about 2 min, no model cost.
catalog.importWhat_one: Imports up to {{count}} task from your copy of the data. No model runs and nothing is charged.
catalog.importWhat_other: Imports up to {{count}} tasks from your copy of the data. No model runs and nothing is charged.
catalog.addAsk: Add {{name}} to your project as benchmark {{id}}? Nothing runs and nothing is charged.
catalog.addAskExample: Add the {{name}} example to your project, with its benchmarks and agents? Nothing runs and nothing is charged.

labelling.created: Queue {{name}} is created. Now add the runs people will label.

source.judgeOf: People check the judge's decisions on {{benchmark}}.

confirm.syncRemove: Remove the weekly sync of {{repo}}? It stops adding tasks. The benchmark and its tasks stay.
confirm.serveStart: Start a GPU on your Modal account for {{hours}} hours? Modal bills you per minute, at most about ${{max}}.
confirm.serveStop: Stop serving {{model}}? Running evaluations that use it will fail.

serve.hoursRange: The time limit is 0.1 to 24 hours.
serve.noEvaluation: No evaluation (stops at the time limit)

problem.benchmark: Benchmark id: use 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits, '.', '-' or '_', starting with a letter or digit.
problem.app: Tool prefix: start with a letter, then up to 31 lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_'.
problem.appReserved: Tool prefix: "customer" is taken by the simulated customer; pick another.
problem.maxUsd: Cost cap: type an amount above 0 in US dollars, or leave it empty.
